description: Two bowls sit on the table in front: a yellow bowl in the middle and a pink bowl on the right, filled with ribbon-like strips. The left hand rests on the table while the right hand uses chopsticks to pinch a few strips from the pink bowl, lift them up, carry them leftward, and release them into the yellow bowl, repeating this transfer several times until the yellow bowl contains a pile and the pink bowl is mostly emptied.
